836. Remove Duplicates from Linked List

50

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Given a singly linked list consisting of N nodes. The task is to remove duplicates (nodes with duplicate values) from the given list (if exists).
input_spec: First line of input contains length of linked list and next line contains the linked list data(separated by space).
output_spec: Single line of output which contains linked list with no duplicates(separated by space).
